name: kb_395_Normalized

https:__kubernetesjsonschema_dev_master_.description: Time is a wrapper around time.Time which supports correct marshaling to YAML and JSON.  Wrappers are provided for many of the factory methods that the time package offers.

schema.description: HorizontalPodAutoscalerCondition describes the state of a HorizontalPodAutoscaler at a certain point.

lastTransitionTime.description: lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another

message.description: message is a human-readable explanation containing details about the transition

reason.description: reason is the reason for the condition's last transition.

status.description: status is the status of the condition (True, False, Unknown)

erroneous_json.message: The HorizontalPodAutoscaler successfully scaled up the deployment from 3 to 5 replicas.

valid_json.message: The HorizontalPodAutoscaler successfully scaled up the deployment from 3 to 5 replicas.

description:
On November 3 2024 at 14:27 UTC the HorizontalPodAutoscaler entered a new condition. The transition, recorded at **2024-11-03T14:27:45Z**, was flagged with the type **AbleToScale** and a status of **True**, indicating that scaling actions are currently permissible.

The system reported the reason for this change as **ScalingUp**, accompanied by a detailed message: *“The HorizontalPodAutoscaler successfully scaled up the deployment from 3 to 5 replicas.”* This confirms that the autoscaler has performed the expected scaling operation.
